 # pr-review-agent
 
-A multi-agent PR review system.
+A multi-agent PR review system powered by Anthropic Claude.
+
+## Quickstart
+
+1. Clone the repo
+2. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill in your keys
+3. Install dependencies: `uv sync`
+4. Run a review: `uv run python -m src.pipeline https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/N`
+
+## Required Environment Variables
+
+| Variable | Description |
+|---|---|
+| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | Anthropic API key for Claude models |
+| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | GitHub PAT with `pull_requests:write` scope |
+| `LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY` | LangFuse observability public key |
+| `LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY` | LangFuse observability secret key |
+| `LANGFUSE_HOST` | LangFuse host (default: `https://cloud.langfuse.com`) |
+
+## Architecture
+
+Three agents run sequentially:
+- **Analyzer**: classifies PR risk (low/medium/high) and selects model tier
+- **Reviewer**: retrieves team standards via MCP and generates structured findings
+- **Reporter**: formats comment, presents HITL gate, posts to GitHub on approval
